title: x402-ping
mainTitle: Base USDC x402 premium ping for agents
subtitle: Free discovery plus a 0.05 USDC /premium paywall on Base for payment-path checks.
description:
## What it does

x402-ping is a live Cloudflare Worker that exposes free tip/unlock discovery on `GET /` and an HTTP 402 exact paywall on `GET /premium` for 0.05 USDC on Base (`eip155:8453`). Settlements go to treasury `0xbAd41cF0f0d5442f9A53630F8081BFd257DA019b`. No accounts or API keys — agents probe free discovery, then pay `/premium` to verify an end-to-end x402 path.

## Best for

- Agents and SDKs validating Base USDC x402 exact payments against a live endpoint.
- Directory crawlers and facilitators that need a cheap, always-on ping resource.
- Builders testing PAYMENT-REQUIRED headers and facilitator settlement on Base.

## Endpoints

- `GET /` — Free discovery JSON (treasury, tip, unlock, network).
- `GET /premium` — Paid ping: HTTP 402 exact 0.05 USDC on Base; returns pong JSON after payment.
- `GET /.well-known/x402` — Agent402 service manifest.
- `GET /.well-known/agent.json` — Agent card.

## Code usage

Inspect the free root:

```bash
curl -sS 'https://x402-ping.palmbeachpete.workers.dev/'
```

Challenge the paid route (expect HTTP 402 + PAYMENT-REQUIRED):

```bash
curl -i 'https://x402-ping.palmbeachpete.workers.dev/premium'
```

Pay with x402 CLI:

```bash
x402-cli pay 'https://x402-ping.palmbeachpete.workers.dev/premium' \
  --method GET \
  --network eip155:8453 \
  --token USDC \
  --scheme exact \
  --max-amount 0.05
```

## Base Mainnet payment

`/premium` uses official USDC on `eip155:8453` with x402 `exact` (EIP-3009 via facilitators). Amount is 50000 atomic units (0.05 USDC).
useCase: Use when an agent needs a live Base USDC x402 ping to verify payment headers, facilitator settlement, or directory health probes.
